name: todo-sidebar
description: Docked right-hand sidebar showing the live TodoWrite list, fixed while the transcript scrolls

showActivityLog.description: Show the tool calls made while the running step is worked on (Read, Edit, Run) under the todo list
showActivityLog.title: Show activity log

summaryEveryPrompts.title: Summary refresh cadence
summaryEveryPrompts.description: Ask the summary model again after this many of your prompts; 0 turns the summary off

summaryModel.title: Helper model
summaryModel.description: Model alias or id used for the session summary and the status keeper (cheap is fine)

statusKeeper.title: Status keeper
statusKeeper.description: After a response in which the agent did not update the todo list, ask the helper model which step statuses changed
